title: 信贷数据低于预期：财政刺激落后计划，转向消费与软基建
speaker: Yang Ming-Miao

segments.en: Well, I think the number kind of reflected that physical is a little bit behind schedule.
segments.zh: 我认为，数据反映出财政刺激有点落后于计划。

segments.en: That's why, you know, the credit number is below expectation.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么信贷数据低于预期。

segments.en: And then, you know, if physical stimulus picking up pace,
segments.zh: 然后，如果财政刺激加快步伐，

segments.en: you should show up both in the traditional sector, in the credit numbers.
segments.zh: 你应该会在传统领域和信贷数据中看到体现。

segments.en: But also, you know, the government just mentioned six networks.
segments.zh: 而且，政府刚刚提到了六张网。

segments.en: So you will see a transition from traditionally from stimulating investment to consumption,
segments.zh: 所以你会看到从传统上刺激投资转向消费的转变，

segments.en: from hard infrastructure to more soft infrastructure.
segments.zh: 从硬基础设施转向更多软基础设施。

segments.en: I think it will be more broader range.
You mentioned the emerging growth driver is AI.
segments.zh: 你提到新兴增长动力是人工智能。

segments.en: Now, how do I look at this play out across the economy?
segments.zh: 那么，我如何看待这在经济中的表现？

segments.en: Is it mostly just going to be seen in the export numbers for now?
segments.zh: 目前主要只体现在出口数据中吗？

segments.en: At what point do you think it's just going to have meaningful contribution to growth?
segments.zh: 你认为它何时会对增长做出有意义的贡献？

segments.en: Well, AI accounted for first eight months, 45% of Chinese export growth.
segments.zh: 嗯，人工智能在前八个月占中国出口增长的45%。

segments.en: So you're already in export growth growth.
segments.zh: 所以你已经看到出口增长。

segments.en: And then I think what you meant is really from export to domestic investment,
segments.zh: 然后我认为你的意思是，从出口到国内投资，
